classification.difficultyReason: Recognise without a supplied rolling method that rotations depend on the moving centre's enlarged circular path, then generalise its radius to (n+1)r.

previousLocalDifficulty.difficultyReason: Identify the circular path of the moving centre and generalise the circumference comparison.

classification.difficultyReason: Eliminate the two sloping sides using three Pythagorean relationships, then reinterpret the altitude as bounded by the semicircle radius to prove an inequality.

questions.mappingNote: Circle-angle-properties is the closest catalogue match for the semicircle reasoning; symbolic repeated Pythagoras is a secondary assessed skill.

previousLocalDifficulty.difficultyReason: Derives a symbolic altitude formula using repeated Pythagoras and uses a semicircle to prove an inequality.
